newsitem.title: UK: Results still awaited in South Africa sugar tender.
newsitem.headline: Results still awaited in South Africa sugar tender.

text.p: Results of South Africa's private tender to sell four cargoes of raw sugar for May/June shipment should emerge in the course of Friday, market sources said.
One said a major European house was rumoured to have bought at least one of the cargoes on offer for onward shipment to Canada.
South Africa issued an invitation-only tender on Thursday to sell two cargoes for May and two for June. Three of the cargoes were C & F basis and the other FOB.
The tender is thought to be the first from the new crop in South Africa, which has been marketing directly to the Far East, the sources said.
